title: Kemper Reports Second Quarter 2026 Operating Results*
summary: Kemper Corporation (NYSE: KMPR) reported second quarter 2026 results, which included a non-cash goodwill impairment of $460 million. This has no impact on the cash-generating ability of our businesses, statutory capital, holding company liquidity, or compliance with our debt and revolving credit covenants. Including this charge, Kemper reported a net loss of $464.8 million, or $(7.90) per share, for the second quarter of 2026, compared to net income of $72.6 million, or $1.12 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2025. Adjusted Consolidated Net Operating Income 1 was $26.3 million, or $0.45 per share, for the second quarter of 2026, compared to Adjusted Consolidated Net Operating Income 1 of $84.1 million, or $1.30 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2025.
